summary: Players can craft the dependency-free Open Modular Turrets progression, feed turrets semantically valid ammunition, hear authoritative combat feedback and safely clear a memory card profile.

authoritative_state: Recipe and item-tag datapacks define the canonical survival acquisition and ammunition sets.
The logical server triggers positional launch and impact sounds after authoritative actions.
MemoryCardItem removes only the memory_card_profile Data Component on a valid clear interaction.

fields: memory_card_profile remains the only custom persistent card field
clearing removes the profile component without replacing the ItemStack or deleting unrelated components

client_boundary.dedicated_server_fallback: Recipes, tags, card interaction and sound event registration load without client-only classes; a headless server dispatches vanilla sound packets normally.

generated: Exactly 61 dependency-free recipes, recipe advancements, corrected item tags and en_us/zh_cn subtitle keys.
manual: sounds.json and 18 legacy OMT ogg files with per-file source and hash recorded.

budgets.scope: One accepted turret shot and one resolved impact
budgets.measurement: Count authoritative world sound dispatches for one non-area projectile shot and impact.

performance.measurement_environment: Java 21, fixed GameTest world, one turret, one projectile and one target.

mods.fallback: The feature is unavailable outside the pinned NeoForge 21.1 line.

criteria.statement: Clearing a populated card removes only memory_card_profile and preserves unrelated ItemStack components.
criteria.observation: After a crouching clear interaction, the same populated Memory Card stack has no memory_card_profile component and retains its unrelated custom name and components.

criteria.statement: Exactly 61 intended recipes are generated and the five declared creative-only ids have none.
criteria.observation: A clean generated-data run produces exactly 61 intended recipe files and no recipe for any of the five declared creative-only ids.

criteria.statement: The runtime recipe manager exposes all 61 intended recipes and none of the five declared creative-only recipe ids.
criteria.observation: After datapack loading, querying the server recipe manager finds all 61 intended ids and finds no recipe for each declared creative-only id.

criteria.statement: Ammunition tags contain gameplay items rather than renderer tokens.
criteria.observation: The generated ammunition tags contain the declared gameplay ammunition items and contain none of the internal renderer-token items.

criteria.statement: SoundEvent ids, sounds.json entries and ogg files reconcile one-to-one.
criteria.observation: The asset gate finds a registered SoundEvent, sounds.json entry and readable OGG resource for every declared sound id, with no unmatched entry.

criteria.statement: Every declared legacy combat sound id is present in the runtime SoundEvent registry.
criteria.observation: After registry bootstrap, looking up every declared legacy combat sound ResourceLocation returns a registered SoundEvent.

criteria.statement: One accepted projectile launch dispatches exactly one positional launch sound from the logical server.
criteria.observation: A server-side sound listener records exactly one launch event at the turret muzzle for one accepted projectile shot.

criteria.statement: One direct bullet impact dispatches exactly one positional impact sound from the logical server.
criteria.observation: A server-side sound listener records exactly one bullet-hit event at the collision position for one direct bullet impact.

criteria.statement: One accepted projectile launch plus one resolved direct impact dispatch no more than two authoritative positional sounds in total.
criteria.observation: The sound-dispatch budget measurement for one accepted launch and one resolved direct impact reports a total count of two or less.

criteria.statement: Sound registration and item interactions load without client classes.
criteria.observation: A dedicated server reaches its ready state with sound registration and Memory Card interaction available and without loading client-only classes.

steps: Craft the tier chain and five formal ammunition types in survival mode.
Fire projectile and ray turrets while listening from near and far positions.
Rename a populated memory card, clear it while crouching in air, and inspect its remaining name.
manual_checks.expected: Crafting outputs match legacy counts, sounds play once with spatial falloff, and card clearing preserves unrelated components.

non_goals: A new recipe for plasma_turret, addon_potentia or internal renderer-token items.
